title: Requirements register — every capability in the brief, with delivery status
rule: Status is judged on what is actually in the repository and running on this site, not on what the plan says. 'blocked' names the specific missing input.

requirements.requirement: Collect and organise a full list of requirements
requirements.note: 19 requirements decomposed from the brief, each with an owner and a verification line.
The resolver, ASIN validator, staleness rule and PA-API client are implemented and unit-tested; they gate hard on missing credentials so they never emit invented data.
Requires a valid ASIN set and a trend signal source. No trend value is asserted anywhere on the site.
Conversion rate is an Amazon-reported metric available only in the Associates dashboard for an existing account.
Prices may only be shown if served by Amazon in the link or pulled from Creators/PA API, and no product was identifiable.
No rating or review count could be read from any official page for the supplied identifiers.
The competitive model, its inputs and its data sources are specified; the scoring function is implemented and tested on fixtures. It has no real inputs to score.
The only official rate source is the signed-in rate card; see F-04. Economics are expressed as a formula with the rate as an input, never as a number.
The generator, the fact-check gate (no sentence without a source) and the disclosure injector are implemented and tested. No article is published, because there is no verified product to write about.
Comparison template enforces the lowest-new/lowest-used display rule from Participation Requirements §2(b). Unfilled pending valid ASINs.
Guide template implemented; needs a verified candidate set before it emits anything.
Niche scoring rubric defined and implemented with weights disclosed. No niche is labelled profitable on this site.
Publishing requires the operator's own Associates ID; a tagged Special Link cannot be constructed without it, and republishing the supplied short link is prohibited. See F-01 and F-08.
Measurement plan defined with an explicit prohibition on per-user sub-tagging, per Participation Requirements §2(b). See F-11.
Scheduled re-verification, staleness expiry and a change-detection loop are specified and stubbed with tests; they require credentials and a live URL to run against.
Idempotent pipeline, schema-validated data files, CI build gate, and a per-ASIN design that does not change shape as the catalogue grows.
Each row carries a source URL and a status; blanks are structural, not editorial.
Each rule quotes the official agreement text and names the code guard that enforces it.

requirements.where: Compliance page → Disclosure section; footer of every page
requirements.note: Amazon's §5 sentence and the FTC placement rules are implemented as a per-page component, not a buried link.
